# S3 containers for heteroscedasticity diagnostics

<small>Source: [`man/hetero_test_suite.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/hetero_test_suite.Rd) · Help: `?hetero_test_suite`</small>

Collections of heteroscedasticity test results returned by `runHeteroTests`.
A `hetero_test_suite` is a simple named list of `htest` objects with
additional metadata. When diagnostics are evaluated on grouped data, the
returned object inherits from `hetero_grouped_suite` and contains one
`hetero_test_suite` per group along with the grouping keys.

## Details

These classes are primarily useful for method dispatch (e.g. the broom tidiers
and `autoplot()` methods). Users typically interact with the objects via
`generics::tidy()`, `generics::glance()`, `generics::augment()`
and `ggplot2::autoplot()`.
